deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$DUT_USER@$DUT_IP"  "echo ---pmbus_names---; head -n 1 /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/name 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'pmbus|psu|power' || echo no_pmbus_dev; echo ---i2c_buses---; sudo i2cdetect -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'smbus|i2c' || echo no_i2c_tools; echo ---reg_QUERY_MFR_SPECIFIC---; sudo i2cget -f -y ${PMBUS_BUS:?set PSU i2c bus} ${PMBUS_ADDR:?set PSU i2c addr} 0xE0 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: enumerate the hwmon PMBus + i2c buses on the DUT so the QUERY via MFR_SPECIFIC register (0x0xE0, the PSU model/capability query via MFR-specific command) can be read; then, once the user supplies the PSU i2c bus+address, read the register with i2cget/i2ctransfer and return the FULL value. Agent returns the PMBus/i2c enumeration + the register value once bus/addr are given.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires the PSU to be PMBus-connected and the exact PSU i2c bus/address from the board schematic; reading a raw PMBus register needs i2c-tools on the DUT. State: read-only, but target bus/address must be verified against the board before using i2cget.

original_test_intent: For each project-selected command from Table 1223, issue the applicable approved QUERY transaction to the identified CRPS PSU, determine reported command support, and validate the complete response information against the command/vendor definition.
original_method: The project supplies the selected command set and, for each entry, target, query transaction, response format and expected support result. The agent executes the approved read-only matrix, retains raw responses/status, decodes and compares each row, repeats for consistency and preserves platform evidence.
manual_activity: No physical core action is inherent. The engineer chooses the command coverage and supplies authoritative read-only transaction semantics; parameters and approval do not make the automated QUERY matrix PARTIAL.
required_inputs: PSU identity/firmware and board bus/address ownership map
Table 1223 revision and exact project-selected command list
Per-command QUERY transaction type, length, PEC, response encoding and expected result
Vendor-specific mappings and rules for unsupported/invalid responses
Approved non-forced PMBus/vendor reader and version
One-user approval and bus recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Do not substitute MFR-specific 0xE0 or any other command for the missing selected Table 1223 entry.
Do not guess transaction width/PEC or use forced access, blind scans, writes, block operations with unknown side effects or a BMC-owned bus without approval.
Use authenticated transport and protect credentials.
Stop on target mismatch, ambiguous response length/encoding, bus error or PSU/BMC/host change.
Preserve logs and do not try another command automatically after an abnormal response.
agent_execution_scope: Validate and display the resolved command matrix before approval.
Execute only approved read-only QUERY transactions through the mapped target path.
Store full raw bytes, exit/transport status, decoded support information and repeat results per command.
Compare expected/actual coverage and compile evidence without issuing the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Select/approve Table 1223 command coverage and authoritative mappings.
Approve target and read-only access/recovery method.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not suitable as acceptance evidence: it guesses 0xE0, does not encode the selected QUERY transaction, uses `-f`, insecure SSH patterns and only partial enumeration; ipmitool is listed but unused and `0x0xE0` is malformed in the description.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Generate a target-locked read-only transaction per approved Table 1223 entry using the vendor/board-approved tool and authenticated transport. Preserve the original proposal as provenance only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged. The source leaves the specific command set to project selection; actual coverage must list every queried entry.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a versioned matrix of selected Table 1223 commands and exact query/response definitions, run it through the approved reader, retain raw outputs and produce per-command support/response results.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the mapped PSU/bus and matching table/vendor definitions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU/BMC firmware, Table 1223/vendor map and reader versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: The applicable project-supplied Table 1223 and PSU command documentation; no generic 0xE0 selection is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces one guessed register with complete parameterized query evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One command proves only that entry; library or project completion must name the selected command coverage and exclusions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Command matrix, target map, response definitions, tool and expected results.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some QUERY responses may be vendor-specific or transport-dependent and require engineer interpretation.

project_override_considerations: The project may select one, several or all applicable Table 1223 commands. Record the exact set and exclusions. Completion of a limited plan must not be presented as support validation for the full table.
expected_evidence: PSU identity, table/vendor revisions and selected command coverage
Per-command target/transaction/response definitions and tool version
Full raw and decoded QUERY responses with exit status and repeat consistency
Per-command expected/actual matrix plus preserved PSU/BMC event delta
Coverage exclusions and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: A 'specific command' and commands listed in the table describe a parameterized per-command test. Project selection determines coverage; the source does not assert two incompatible operations.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The parameterized QUERY intent is clear. Missing selection/mapping/package are readiness inputs rather than permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject its hard-coded MFR-specific substitution and forced command while preserving the idea of automated read evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with per-command selection and safe read gates, but reclassify from PARTIAL to FULLY AUTOMATABLE once inputs are supplied.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates command coverage and approval from execution capability and prevents one-entry false completion.

review_improvement: This review restores the source's parameterized command scope, records coverage explicitly and removes an unsourced single-register substitution. It also applies the rule that input/spec dependencies do not reduce a fully automatable read-only core.
independent_technical_reasoning: After command/response semantics are supplied, the full core—query, capture, repeat, decode and compare—is automatable. Human work is configuration and final judgment, not test execution. Therefore FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct, with project-selected coverage made explicit.
